name: Follow Up Boss
description: Connect your own Follow Up Boss (FUB) real-estate CRM account to manage leads, contacts, deals, and follow-up activity from Imperal -- People (contacts) with tags, custom fields, and relationships; lead intake via Events (the correct, automation-triggering way to add leads, not raw People creation); Deals and Pipelines/Stages; Tasks and Notes; Calls and Text Messages (with templates); Appointments (with types/outcomes); Users, Teams/Groups/Ponds; Custom Fields; Smart Lists; Automations 2.0 / legacy Action Plans; Webhooks; plus value-add reports (stale-lead detection, agent response-time audit, pipeline health) not available in the native FUB UI. Uses your own personal API Key -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

panels.title: How to connect Follow Up Boss

pricing.notes: Connection/identity management free. list/get reads = 8. create/update/delete CRUD = 16. Higher-stakes single actions (lead intake via events, sending a text message, applying/removing/triggering automations) = 20. Imperal value-add analytics reports (lead response audit, pipeline health, overdue tasks, agent activity, stale leads) = 40, reflecting the multi-endpoint aggregation each report performs.
